Define mutable record classes `Project`, `Milestone`, and `Deliverable`, each exposing a string `id` and Boolean `frozen`. Also define `Portfolio` with these methods:
- `add_project(project_id)`

- `add_deliverable(deliverable_id, milestone_id)`
- `freeze_project(project_id)`
- `frozen_ids(kind)`

IDs must be non-empty strings and globally unique across all three record types. Invalid IDs raise `ValueError`; duplicate IDs raise `ValueError`; unknown parent IDs raise `KeyError`. Newly added records are not frozen.

Freezing a project must freeze that project, all of its milestones, and every deliverable under those milestones. Repeating the operation is harmless. Freezing one project must not affect another.

`frozen_ids(kind)` accepts exactly `"project"`, `"milestone"`, or `"deliverable"`; other values raise `ValueError`. It returns a newly created tuple of matching frozen IDs sorted lexicographically. An empty portfolio or a kind with no frozen records returns `()`.

Relationships and records must be owned by the portfolio; query results must not expose mutable internal collections.

import unittest

from solution import Deliverable, Milestone, Portfolio, Project


class PortfolioTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_record_classes_are_mutable_and_expose_fields(self):
        for cls, identifier in ((Project, "p"), (Milestone, "m"), (Deliverable, "d")):
            with self.subTest(cls=cls):
                record = cls(identifier)
                self.assertEqual(record.id, identifier)
                self.assertIs(record.frozen, False)
                record.frozen = True
                self.assertIs(record.frozen, True)

    def test_freeze_project_cascades_only_within_project(self):
        portfolio = Portfolio()
        portfolio.add_project("p2")
        portfolio.add_project("p1")
        portfolio.add_milestone("m2", "p1")
        portfolio.add_milestone("m1", "p1")
        portfolio.add_milestone("m3", "p2")
        portfolio.add_deliverable("d2", "m1")
        portfolio.add_deliverable("d1", "m2")
        portfolio.add_deliverable("d3", "m3")
        portfolio.freeze_project("p1")
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("project"), ("p1",))
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("milestone"), ("m1", "m2"))
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("deliverable"), ("d1", "d2"))
        portfolio.freeze_project("p1")
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("deliverable"), ("d1", "d2"))

    def test_empty_queries_and_fresh_tuple_results(self):
        portfolio = Portfolio()
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("project"), ())
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("milestone"), ())
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("deliverable"), ())
        portfolio.add_project("project")
        self.assertEqual(portfolio.frozen_ids("project"), ())
        portfolio.freeze_project("project")
        first = portfolio.frozen_ids("project")
        second = portfolio.frozen_ids("project")
        self.assertEqual(first, ("project",))
        self.assertEqual(second, ("project",))
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_invalid_and_duplicate_ids(self):
        portfolio = Portfolio()
        for invalid in ("", 1, None, True):
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    portfolio.add_project(invalid)
        portfolio.add_project("shared")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            portfolio.add_project("shared")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            portfolio.add_milestone("shared", "shared")
        portfolio.add_milestone("milestone", "shared")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            portfolio.add_deliverable("milestone", "milestone")
        portfolio.add_deliverable("deliverable", "milestone")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            portfolio.add_project("deliverable")

    def test_unknown_parents_and_projects(self):
        portfolio = Portfolio()
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            portfolio.add_milestone("m", "missing")
        portfolio.add_project("p")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            portfolio.add_deliverable("d", "missing")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            portfolio.freeze_project("missing")

    def test_kind_validation(self):
        portfolio = Portfolio()
        for kind in ("projects", "", None, 1, True):
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    portfolio.frozen_ids(kind)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
